title: 2165. Smallest Value of the Rearranged Number

examples.explanation: The possible arrangements for the digits of 310 are 013, 031, 103, 130, 301, 310. The arrangement with the smallest value that does not contain any leading zeros is 103.
Some possible arrangements for the digits of -7605 are -7650, -6705, -5076, -0567. The arrangement with the smallest value that does not contain any leading zeros is -7650.
